body:
That video didn't show any hacks, I personally only saw myself spin rationally to kit the players.
I think the most disgusting thing is your staff. Kycrafft is the first Ill point out. first of all he claims to be a female and he has some "client lag" and got kicked once again. but that's not all https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pxr3CGu9eJI and https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aLC4PyQaN4s. Those videos prove hacks or anything.   
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TJFJkWgbP08 watch mine again, watch how you see me turn to get the first and second. notice how the first only got hit when I turned around to face him and how i only hit the third once then my  team mate killed him while i did nothing. that video doesn't prove anything. those look fine to me. The only thing that makes me look like im using hacks is how I knew that second guy was there and that's because I was watching him the whole time just as you were. you should also know that my internet crashed that game as I was lagging badly. remember i stopped on the hill or going up the hill and then I get banned and you catch me and I know that dam well I don't hack and there are bigger hackers in your pool of players.

title: You really think I hack

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body:
After watching the video in slow motion it is obvious that you were snapping directly to the player after every hit you dealt. I do admit that the third instance of you fighting had little evidence of hacking, however the first two instances (and the previous PvP encounters prior to the recording) very clearly displayed you using aim assistance. Therefore, I banned you for toggle aimbot.

"notice how the first only got hit when I turned around to face" I can see you blatantly spin to the player every time s/he was not directly in your crosshair. You may have been turning around to hit the player, but you weren't doing it legitimenity. I'm sorry, but two moderators saw you hacking, and I am obligated to punish for that. 


I'd now like to address your arguements in your first paragraph. Yes, sometimes I lag, however the client lag kick is extremely outdated. My other warn may have been deserved, but I do not believe it to be a serious enough infraction to hold against my ability to moderate. Next, I actually had not realized that my profile still identifies me as "female" it was a joke that I made with some of my friends a long time ago and I have since forgotten about it. But who are you to decide what I can and cannot say about myself? What if I wanted to identify as a female? Would that make you or me disgusting? Now, I don't actually identify as a female, but making ignorant assumptions that I am disgusting for claiming to be one does not put you on any high ground. Finally, I'll address those videos. My friend ducksfanwaterloo decided to make those two videos as a joke. He was recording me while I was derping around with my mouse on high sensitivity whislt playing with other players on TeamSpeak. I will note that he tried to over-exaggerate his expression to me 'hacking'. You may ask Ducksfanwaterloo if you want more information. Sorry for the confusion.
